title: Add project coverage thresholds before opening a PR

trace.prose: After drafting an implementation plan, submit it to the Plan Review Gate. All 3 reviewers must PASS.
Before implementation, the Design Review Gate must approve. Skipping it after brainstorming is an anti-pattern.
IMPLEMENT then always VALIDATE. Do not combine phases.
VALIDATE includes coverage enforcement as a BLOCKING gate. Coverage command failed means VALIDATION FAIL, not proceed.
REVIEW to COMMIT only if adversarial review returns PASS. FAIL retries with a fresh reviewer.
After final review passes but BEFORE creating the PR, run /self-reflect. Mandatory.
